knowledge_gaps: The residual is not actually bounded: softplus(a) is unbounded even though tanh(c*r) is bounded. Specify a capped gate, score scaling, and initialization that permits useful gradients.

Leave-occurrence-out construction is underspecified. Positive and negative candidates must use the same adjusted transition table for each supervised position. Removing one edge also leaves other transitions from the same user's later history; user-level cross-fitting is a useful alternative, with its training–inference distribution shift explicitly assessed.

Reproduction requires exact transition normalization, support shrinkage, top-k selection, recency weights, padding handling, and causal prefix alignment. The current diagnostic interface carries no user or occurrence identifier, complicating exact occurrence removal.

The selected transition branch lacks comparisons against established Markov hybrids, a transition-only scorer, and a popularity residual. These controls would reveal whether improvements come from sequential information or popularity shortcuts. The originality score of 5 is weakly supported.

No baseline validation HR@10, transition coverage measurements, or budgeted ablation schedule is provided. Training margins alone do not justify prioritizing this architecture over the simpler loss change. With 200 users per category, repeated validation selection also risks overfitting.
